intro: Plaguewood Tower is a ruined Lordaeron scout tower situated in the northern reaches of the Plaguewood near Terrordale. Shattered during the Scourge invasion, it now stands as a broken ruin amid the blighted forest.

sections.t: A Ruined Sentinel in the North
p: Standing on the edge of the blight-choked Plaguewood and the blighted town of Terrordale, Plaguewood Tower once served the Kingdom of Lordaeron as a vital northern watchpost. When the Scourge swept across the land, the fortification was battered into crumbling masonry and left in ruins amid corrupted fungal canopies. Today the fractured stones still overlook the northern trails, a silent reminder of the watch Lordaeron once kept over this land.
